subject.title: feat(dashboard): pinned MCP apps — board rendering, lease re-mint, durable tool grants

question: Should durable, operator-granted MCP App interactivity on session dashboards become a supported core dashboard contract after the two concrete authorization/UI fixes are made?
rationale: The branch adds a broad persistent dashboard capability and a new gateway method; code review can identify defects, but maintaining this long-term product and protocol surface requires explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor the dashboard contract
options.body: Keep the feature direction, require the two repairs plus real Control UI proof, and review the resulting protocol and upgrade contract.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Limit the feature to read-only pinned MCP App rendering and defer durable tool grants and lease renewal to a separately owned design.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this broad dashboard capability until an owner confirms its product and protocol scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the dashboard contract
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, require the two repairs plus real Control UI proof, and review the resulting protocol and upgrade contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this person as the active contributor across the proposed board, gateway, and UI design.
